processes, enabling BRSR compliance and GRI alignment; ran GRI / BRSR readiness and gap assessments across 45+ indicators. 
• GHG & decarbonisation advisory: Developed GHG inventories and emission profiles on advisory engagements and advised on

Independent assurance & verification (ISAE 3000 · ISO 14064)

• GHG verification: Verified Scope 1/2/3 GHG inventories (GHG Protocol / ISO 14064) across 75+ manufacturing and industrial
